job.title: Director City Development - City of Nedlands
job.description:
THE CITY

The City of Nedlands is a Band 2 Local Government with a vibrant, diverse and engaged community. Situated just 7km from Perth and with a population of over 22,000, the City stretches from the banks of the beautiful Swan River to the edge of the Indian Ocean. The City is at a crucial juncture with a newly appointed Elected Member group in addition to a newly appointed Chief Executive Officer, looking to fill the role of Director City Development, to assist in positioning the organisation for long-term success.

THE ROLE

Reporting to the newly appointed Chief Executive Officer, the Director City Development will be a pivotal member of the Executive Leadership Team. You will provide strategic leadership across planning and building approvals, health and compliance, while also driving the review and redevelopment of the City's land and property portfolio. As the City experiences rapid growth, the successful candidate will play a key role in shaping high-value developments, urban infill and increased density. You will grow the City's commercially focused shared services to nearby local governments and build strong, credible relationships with State Government, industry and developers.

REQUIREMENTS

To ensure success in this critical role, the new Director City Development will have deep technical knowledge of planning and development in a Local Government context. A proven people leader, you will be adaptable and comfortable leading change, with the demonstrated commercial acumen to grow shared services, manage complex planning and property redevelopment. The ideal candidate will have sound analytical and stakeholder management skills and the ability to foster and cultivate a high-performing team with a people‑centred approach.

IN RETURN

A contract of five years is on offer and an attractive base salary of up to $240,000 plus superannuation plus car allowance. Co-contribution of superannuation, five weeks’ annual leave, Professional Development and flexible work arrangements are also on offer for the successful candidate.

To apply please click the Apply Now button or visit www.beilbydt.com.au quoting reference 1261401. Please provide a comprehensive resume together with a covering letter of up to three pages, addressing the Selection Criteria found within the Application Pack.

Download an Application Pack by clicking or copying and pasting this link in your browser: https://beilbydt.com.au/application-packs

For initial enquiries, or for any assistance you may need in making your application, please contact Emily Bulloch for a confidential discussion on 0427 582 402 or ebulloch@beilbydt.com.au.

Applications will close at 4pm AWST on Wednesday 2 December 2026.

Canvassing of Elected Members will disqualify.

job.title: Executive Director Corporate - City of Swan
job.description:
THE CITY

The City of Swan is Perth’s largest local government by land size, covering 1,042 square kilometres which is almost 20 per cent of the Perth metropolitan area. This City is home to a dynamic and diverse community, with one in three residents born overseas, and almost one in four speaking a language other than English at home. The City has one of the fastest-growing populations in WA, with the population expected to soar from around 179,207 in 2024 to about 300,000 by 2050.

THE ROLE

The Executive Director Corporate is a crucial role for the City, overseeing its $271 million budget and leading a team of over 100 FTE. In addition to leading the financial services, rates, information services and human resources areas, this role is also involved with the City’s commercial and tourism portfolios. Reporting to the CEO and working closely with Elected Members, the successful candidate will be required to undertake continuous stakeholder relationship management, lead complex enterprise agreement negotiations and ensure the successful implementation of the City’s digital strategy.

REQUIREMENTS

The ideal candidate for this role is a Local Government professional with a finance background, a strategic mindset and experience of leading digital transformation. Executive leadership experience is highly desirable as is the ability to drive high performance and form excellent working relationships with Elected Members and key stakeholders.

THE PACKAGE

In return you will receive a generous base salary of $284,000 plus superannuation and a motor vehicle or vehicle allowance. Additionally, 12 days Executive Leave in addition to four weeks annual leave and two Local Government days is on offer as is a generous Professional Development allowance.

To apply please click the Apply Now button or visit www.beilbydt.com.au quoting reference 1261862. Please provide a comprehensive resume together with a covering letter of up to three pages, addressing the Selection Criteria you will find within the Application Pack.

job.title: CAD Drafter (AutoCAD)
job.description:
The Opportunity

Our client is seeking an experienced CAD Drafter for an initial three-month contract, commencing as soon as possible. The role will focus on reviewing, updating and standardising technical drawings across a portfolio of approximately 30 facilities.

Working independently, you will be responsible for converting legacy Public Works drawings into a new drawing standard and producing accurate Works As Executed (WAE) documentation for inclusion within Operations & Maintenance manuals.

This is an excellent opportunity for a detail-oriented AutoCAD professional who is available to start immediately, enjoys project-based work and takes pride in producing high-quality, accurate technical documentation.

Key Responsibilities
  • Review and interpret existing Public Works drawings and documentation
  • Convert and redraw legacy drawings to align with current drafting standards
  • Produce accurate Works As Executed (WAE) drawings for O&M manuals
  • Ensure consistency and accuracy across drawings for approximately 30 buildings
  • Maintain drawing registers and project documentation
  • Work autonomously to deliver project outcomes within established timeframes
About You

To be successful in this role, you will bring:
  • Demonstrated experience as a CAD Drafter, Draftsperson or AutoCAD Technician
  • Strong AutoCAD proficiency and technical drafting capability
  • Ability to interpret existing drawings and replicate drawing standards accurately
  • High attention to detail and commitment to quality documentation
  • Strong organisational skills and ability to manage your workload independently
  • Availability to commence at short notice
  • Experience within engineering, manufacturing, utilities, construction, infrastructure or building services environments will be highly regarded
Why This Role
  • Casual contract engagement for an initial three-month period with an ASAP start
  • Competitive hourly rate of $45-$50 per hour plus superannuation
  • Flexible, project-focused environment
  • Opportunity to work independently and take ownership of a significant drawing conversion project
  • Newcastle/Hunter based assignment
For a confidential discussion regarding this opportunity, please contact Jessica O'Neill on 0457 336 833. Applications can be submitted via the Apply button.

job.title: Distribution Manager
job.description:
About the Company

With more than 50 years of history in Western Australia, our client is an established supplier of timber, hardware and building products across WA. The business is now looking to strengthen and modernise its distribution operations, creating an opportunity for an experienced Distribution Manager to drive performance, develop its people and improve the way the operation works.

The Opportunity

This is an opportunity to take ownership of an end to end distribution operation encompassing warehousing, inventory management, order fulfilment, despatch and delivery coordination. Reporting directly to the Head of People, Culture & Operations, the Distribution Manager will be responsible for strengthening workforce productivity, inventory accuracy, order fulfilment, delivery performance and cost efficiency.

A critical focus will be leading the transition from established paper-based and manual processes towards efficient, system-driven workflows, maximising the capabilities of the existing ERP platform. This is a hands on leadership role requiring someone who can develop working leaders, establish accountability and successfully lead people through meaningful operational change.

About You

The successful candidate will have strong commercial acumen with a clear focus on productivity improvement and cost control.
To be successful, the following will be required:
  • Sound experience improving workforce productivity, inventory accuracy, order fulfilment, delivery performance and cost efficiency.
  • Previously personally lead or played a substantial role in transitioning manual or paper-based processes into system-driven workflows
  • Strong people leadership capability, including developing working leaders, establishing accountability and manage performance and successfully lead teams through change.
  • Proven ability to improve the utilisation and adoption of an existing ERP, warehouse or inventory management system.
  • A visible, hands-on leadership style, comfortable working closely with operational teams while maintaining strong planning and management disciplines.
  • Strong continuous improvement capability, with experience identifying inefficiencies and delivering measurable, sustainable improvements.
  • Experience within building materials, timber, hardware, construction supply or a similar trade distribution environment would be highly regarded.
Importantly, this role requires proven leadership of an end-to-end warehouse and distribution operation.

Why This Role?

This is an excellent opportunity to take ownership of an established operation and lead meaningful change, modernisation and continuous improvement across the business.

Interested candidates are encouraged to apply via the “Apply for this job” button or through our website at www.beilbydt.com.au, quoting reference number 1261856. For further inquiries, please contact Aaron Hooper at ahooper@beilbydt.com.au

job.title: Lead Planner
job.description:
The Company
Our client is an ASX-listed Australian gold development company focused on advancing a significant brownfields project in Western Australia.

Following a successful capital raise and project acquisition, the company has refocused its strategy on progressing the asset toward development and establishing itself as a mid-tier Australian gold producer.

With drilling, technical studies and optimisation work underway, the project is currently progressing through pre-feasibility activities, with a pathway toward potential first production in 2028, subject to required studies, approvals and development decisions.
  
The Opportunity
 
This will be a Perth based role with travel to site as required, the Lead Planner will take ownership of the development, integration and control of the project schedule as the asset progresses from studies through development and execution.

Reporting to the Project Controls Manager, the role will be responsible for establishing and maintaining the integrated project schedule across engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning and handover. A key priority will be developing a robust baseline schedule that provides clear visibility of project logic, critical-path activities, milestones, interfaces and delivery risks.

The role will work closely with project management, engineering, commercial, site and contractor teams to ensure planning inputs are accurate, integrated and aligned with the project’s delivery strategy.

About You

You will be an experienced Lead Planner or accomplished Senior Planner with strong hands-on scheduling capability and the confidence to take ownership of planning.

You will ideally bring:
  • At least five years’ planning and scheduling experience within mining, resources, infrastructure or major capital projects
  • Experience as a Lead Planner, or as a Senior Planner with responsibility for independently developing and controlling complex project schedules
  • Demonstrated experience developing baseline schedules from project scope, WBS and delivery strategy
  • Advanced Primavera P6 capability
  • Strong understanding of schedule logic, critical-path analysis, float, progress measurement and forecasting
  • Experience integrating engineering, procurement, construction and commissioning schedules
  • Strong cost and schedule integration capability
  • Experience reviewing and integrating contractor schedules
  • Greenfields or brownfields mining project experience, ideally across study and execution phases
  • A relevant qualification in engineering, project management, construction management or a related discipline 
Why This Role

This is an excellent  opportunity to join a fast-moving ASX-listed gold development company, giving employees the chance to be part of a company scaling up toward mid-tier producer status. On offer it an excellent salary package commensurate to experience.

Please apply via the “Apply for this job” button or online at www.beilbydt.com.au quoting reference number 1034135.  For initial enquiries or assistance with your application, please contact Aaron Hooper at ahooper@beilbydt.com.au

job.title: Site Supervisor
job.description:
The Company

Earthscape Technologies is an innovative Australian business delivering practical construction, engineering and manufacturing solutions across a range of industries. Its capabilities include mobile roll forming, long-span structural cladding and specialist systems for feedlots and agricultural projects, with a focus on creating simpler, safer and more cost-effective outcomes.

The Opportunity

Earthscape Technologies is seeking an experienced Site Supervisor to lead the day-to-day delivery of construction activities across regional and remote project sites. Working on a 3 weeks on / 1 week off roster, you will coordinate specialist trades, maintain site productivity and ensure projects are completed safely, efficiently, to specification and within agreed timeframes and budgets.

This is a practical, hands-on position for someone who can take ownership of site performance, solve problems quickly and build productive relationships with subcontractors, customers and project stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities
  • Plan and oversee daily construction activities in line with drawings, specifications, schedules and quality standards
  • Coordinate concrete, structural steel, electrical and earthworks contractors
  • Monitor progress, resolve site constraints and implement practical solutions to keep projects moving
  • Manage labour, equipment, materials and trade sequencing to minimise downtime and unnecessary costs
  • Lead site safety, including inductions, pre-starts, SWMS, risk assessments, permits and compliance requirements
  • Monitor workmanship, subcontractor performance, productivity and site-level costs
  • Identify scope changes, variations and emerging commercial issues
  • Maintain accurate site records, progress reports, inspection documentation and project communications
  • Build positive relationships with rural and agricultural customers while minimising disruption to their operations
About You

This role will suit a capable construction supervisor with strong trade coordination, safety leadership and commercial awareness. You will be comfortable working independently in regional and remote environments and taking a practical approach to project delivery.

We would like to speak with candidates who can demonstrate:
  • A current QBCC Site Supervisor Licence (Open Class) or QBCC Builder Licence (Open Class)
  • Experience supervising multi-trade construction projects involving concrete, structural steel, electrical and earthworks
  • The ability to interpret engineering drawings, construction specifications and relevant Australian Standards
  • Sound knowledge of WHS legislation, risk management and site compliance
  • Strong communication, leadership and problem-solving skills
  • Commercial awareness across labour utilisation, subcontractor performance, costs and project variations
  • A current White Card and driver licence
  • Willingness to travel and work a 3 weeks on / 1 week off FIFO or DIDO roster
Experience delivering projects in regional, remote or agricultural environments will be highly regarded.

Why This Role

This is an opportunity to join an innovative Australian business and take ownership of varied construction projects across regional and rural Australia. Earthscape is at an exciting stage of its growth, and this is an ideal time to join the team in this key leadership role.  Run projects in the crowded city or out in beautiful regional Australia....that's an easy decision.

Please apply via the “Apply for this job” button or online at www.beilbydt.com.au. For further information, please contact Mark Turner on 0401 404 451.
